data.body_html:
Plan the ultimate Marbella family boat day jetski snorkel paddleboard combo 2028 and treat your loved ones to a full day of sun, sea, and adventure. Departing from Puerto Banús, our private charters combine the freedom of a luxury boat with thrilling water toys — all included in one transparent price. Whether you choose a compact Astondoa 40 or a spacious Mangusta 80 with a free jetski, you’ll enjoy a skipper-led voyage to the Costa del Sol’s best coves and beaches.

Why choose a family boat day in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline offers calm, clear waters perfect for families. A private charter means you set the pace: anchor at Cala del Faro for snorkelling, cruise to Cabopino for paddleboarding, or ride a jetski along the Golden Mile. No queues, no crowded tour boats — just your group and a dedicated skipper. With average summer temperatures of 30°C and sea temperatures around 24°C, conditions are ideal from May through October.

Our boats for the combo experience

We offer two budget-friendly options for families under our Tier A pricing, plus a premium upgrade with a free jetski. All depart from Puerto Banús.

All prices include skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% VAT. The Mangusta 80 also includes a free jetski for the duration of the charter.

What’s included in the family combo

Every booking comes with a licensed skipper who knows the best spots for snorkelling and paddleboarding. We provide snorkel masks and fins, a paddleboard, and inflatable water toys on request. The Mangusta 80 adds a jetski at no extra cost. On board, you’ll find a fridge stocked with drinks and snacks, plus a shaded cockpit for escaping the sun. Fuel is included, so you can cruise as far as Estepona or Sotogrande without worrying about extra charges.

Sample itinerary for a 6-hour charter

  • 10:00 – Meet at Puerto Banús, meet your skipper, safety briefing.
  • 10:15 – Depart towards Cala del Faro (20 min cruise). Anchor, snorkel, paddleboard.
  • 12:00 – Cruise to Cabopino beach (15 min). Swim and relax on the sand.
  • 13:00 – Lunch at a beachfront chiringuito or on board (own cost).
  • 14:30 – Jetski session (Mangusta 80) or more paddleboarding.
  • 15:30 – Return cruise to Puerto Banús, enjoy drinks and snacks.
  • 16:00 – Disembark.

This is just a suggestion — your skipper will adapt to your preferences and weather conditions.

How to book your family boat day

Booking is easy. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and any special requests. We require a 50% deposit to secure the date, with the balance due 7 days before departure. For summer 2028, we recommend booking at least two weeks in advance, especially for weekends. All prices are in euros and include Spanish VAT. No hidden fees.

If you’re looking for a different experience, explore our full range of Marbella boat charters or check out our experiences page for more ideas.
